paths.description: Public homepage age gate, representing the only reachable unauthenticated surface.
Primary entry journey. Clicking Accept & Verify age redirects to Agerify and requests a selfie or government ID; stopped before personal-data submission.
Listing, video detail/playback, category, search, and account templates were not covered because they remain behind mandatory age verification. Sitemap discovery was also challenged.
English, German, Spanish, Russian, and Japanese content variants advertised by hreflang were not covered because core templates remain behind mandatory age verification.

findings.summary: The gate uses a fixed dark palette instead of responding to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The normal and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots are visually identical, while the computed root color-scheme is "normal" and no preference-driven scheme is declared.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and express surface, text, border, and control colors with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), retaining the current dark design as one supported scheme.

findings.summary: Modal surfaces are implemented as custom divs rather than native dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows #cbDocumentViewer and the chat panel as DIV elements with role=dialog; #cbDocumentViewer is not hidden even when visually closed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal document and chat surfaces, call showModal()/close(), and rely on native focus containment, Escape handling, and inert background behavior.

findings.summary: The existing-user Login action is not keyboard focusable.
findings.evidence: The visible LOGIN control is an <a> without href. Calling focus() leaves document.activeElement elsewhere and its computed outline is none; Lighthouse also identifies it as a non-crawlable anchor.
findings.suggestedFix: Render Login as a real <button type="button"> when it opens a modal, or as an <a href="/login/…"> when it navigates. Preserve a visible :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: Even the lightweight age gate misses the good LCP threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP/FCP at 2.65 s and the CDP trace measured LCP/FCP at 2.95 s; the good LCP threshold is 2.5 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the gate’s critical CSS and HTML, remove gate-unneeded dependencies, and verify LCP under throttled mobile conditions until it remains at or below 2.5 s.

findings.summary: A large site-wide stylesheet delays rendering of the age gate.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports the 93 KiB black-blue.min.css as render-blocking with an estimated 1,180 ms saving; the HAR also records the stylesheet as the largest transferred resource.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline a minimal gate-critical stylesheet and load the full site stylesheet only after verification or with non-blocking delivery appropriate to the next view.

findings.summary: The gate downloads substantial code that it does not use.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 89 KiB unused CSS and 66 KiB unused JavaScript, including about 75% of scripts.min.js and 64% of jQuery.
findings.suggestedFix: Create a gate-specific entry point and stylesheet; defer jQuery and the full application bundle until verification succeeds.

findings.summary: Visible onclick-only anchors are not exposed with the semantics of their intended controls.
findings.evidence: The Login and Manage Cookies controls are <a> elements without href or an explicit button role; direct DOM inspection shows Login cannot receive programmatic focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native buttons for script-triggered actions and anchors with href for navigation; retain concise accessible names.

findings.summary: Keyboard users cannot reach the visible Login action on the blocking gate.
findings.evidence: A direct focus probe on .cb-age-login a reports isFocused=false and outline "none" because the anchor has no href.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the pseudo-link with a native button or valid link and verify a complete Tab sequence with visible focus through Verify, Login, policy, and consent actions.

findings.summary: The loaded Cloudflare challenge script triggers deprecated API warnings.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three deprecation warnings, including Shared Storage, persistent StorageType, and Protected Audience API usage in the Cloudflare challenge script.
findings.suggestedFix: Review the enabled Cloudflare challenge/browser-integrity configuration and vendor version; remove or update the integration that injects deprecated APIs.

findings.summary: robots.txt is invalid and action-like anchors lack href values.
findings.evidence: robots.txt returns age-gate HTML rather than robots directives, producing 13 Lighthouse parse errors; Lighthouse also flags Login and Manage Cookies as non-crawlable anchors.
findings.suggestedFix: Exempt /robots.txt from the age gate and return valid text/plain directives. Use href-bearing links for navigation and buttons for in-page actions.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are inconsistent at the public entry point.
findings.evidence: The page declares index,follow and hreflang variants but has no canonical link; /robots.txt returns gate prose and /sitemap.xml produced a Cloudflare challenge/noindex response in direct retrieval.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve machine-readable robots and sitemap responses outside the gate, add a self-referencing canonical, and verify all hreflang alternates return reciprocal, indexable pages.

findings.summary: The public homepage exposes no structured data or social preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and zero Open Graph tags, despite the page being presented as an indexable public video service.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata that describes the age-gated homepage without exposing restricted media.

findings.summary: The Content-Security-Policy only controls framing and does not mitigate script injection.
findings.evidence: Header evidence records Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' with no default-src, script-src, object-src, or base-uri directives; the page contains many inline scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce- or hash-based CSP with default-src, script-src, object-src none, and base-uri restrictions while retaining frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: The referrer policy permits full HTTPS URLs to be sent to other HTTPS origins.
findings.evidence: The response uses Referrer-Policy: no-referrer-when-downgrade rather than a privacy-preserving strict-origin policy; the mandatory flow navigates to an external age-verification provider.
findings.suggestedFix: Use strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter) and explicitly review the age-verifier handoff so URL paths and query data are not disclosed unnecessarily.

findings.summary: The mandatory age-verification flow cannot proceed without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML includes a noscript warning that the site cannot be used without JavaScript, while the visible verification button relies on onclick=startAgeVerification(); the crawler view can render gate copy but cannot enter.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the verification control a server-handled form action or real navigation URL, then enhance it with JavaScript. Keep policy and recovery routes usable without scripting.

findings.summary: The site advertises an app manifest that is not reliably retrievable.
findings.evidence: The page links /manifest.json and declares mobile-web-app-capable, but the HAR records two 403 responses for the manifest and no controlling service worker is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Exclude the manifest from challenge/gate rules, return a valid manifest with the correct content type, and either provide a useful offline fallback or remove installability claims.

findings.summary: The pre-verification gate performs avoidable network and code work.
findings.evidence: The gate transfers 262 KiB across 14 requests while Lighthouse finds 89 KiB unused CSS and 66 KiB unused JavaScript; jQuery and the full site bundle load before access is granted.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a minimal gate bundle and defer application, analytics, chat, and media dependencies until consent and age verification make them necessary.
